messages.subject: problem with installing source files
parts:
I am getting the following error when I am trying to install any of the source files.As an example-

source("http://phylo.wdfiles.com/local--files/biogeobears/BioGeoBEARS_classes_v1.R")


Error in file(filename, "r", encoding = encoding) : 
  cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In file(filename, "r", encoding = encoding) :
  InternetOpenUrl failed: 'A connection with the server could not be established'


I am not sure if I have done anything wrong with the code, or there are problems with the online server.

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] problem with installing source files
parts:
It probably just means your internet, or wikidot's, failed momentarily. The link works for me right now:
http://phylo.wdfiles.com/local--files/biogeobears/BioGeoBEARS_classes_v1.R

Some people get tired of source()-ing the remote files, you can also download each file to a local directory on your hard drive and source() the file there. This will be faster and not subject to internet outages.

Cheers, 
Nick
